blocks.text: The country has a supply-demand imbalance, and it once again showed its ugly teeth last August. The situation was years in the making and is far from over. A snapshot of January to early September 2026 saw close to 100 yellow and over 30 red alerts being raised in the Visayas grid alone. Mindanao has recorded 14 yellow and five red alerts. And no, this isn’t about system loss — a debate on what words appear on paper. Rather, this is about the hard-nosed numbers that exhibit the country’s energy insecurities.
